input: Write morning journal entries for 30 days

gold.taskTitle: Write Morning Journal Entries for 30 Days
gold.taskDescription: Build a consistent 30-day habit of writing morning journal entries.

questions.title: What specific time will you write each morning?
questions.description: Identify the exact time slot the user plans to journal each day.

questions.title: How long should each journal entry be?
questions.description: Determine the target length or word count per entry.

questions.title: What is the main purpose behind this journaling habit?
questions.description: Understand the core motivation, such as mental clarity, gratitude, self-reflection, or creativity.

questions.title: Will you use prompts or write freely each day?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants guided prompts or open-ended free writing.

questions.title: Which medium will you journal in, digital or paper?
questions.description: Establish whether the user will use a physical notebook or a digital tool or app.

questions.title: Which day does your 30-day challenge start?
questions.description: Pin down the exact start date so the plan has a clear timeline.

questions.title: How will you track whether you completed each day?
questions.description: Identify the accountability or tracking method the user wants to use.
